> CVE-2026-20320                        
  Cisco: BroadWorks XXE Data Leak

  BroadWorks allows unauthenticated     
  remote adversaries to steal sensitive 
  configuration files. CISA ordered     
  federal agencies to apply vendor      
  updates by Nov 24.
